basis_tag: offline enumeration over the frozen E0c/oof_clean node population; NO score here
what_this_is: The union candidate surface for ONE GPU inference pass. The cache holds the union of pairs any arm can need; EVERY final arm still applies the original 6/10 um radius to its own residual. This is offline enumeration, not deployment-time widening.

node_population.rule: UNCHANGED for every arm; the kernel re-hashes its detections and hard-fails on mismatch

surfaces.S4_core: |p_t1 - (p_t + f_knn + pc_shift)| <= 10.0 um, bilateral acquisition core only (global_translation / deformation / intensity_discontinuity)
surfaces.flow_estimator: kNN16 median displacement over unique raw continuations (k=16, min=4), rebuilt from the RAW geff edges after the wrapper's next-frame and <=14um pre-filters -- GT-free and available at motion-relink time

existing_cache_comparison.note: the E0c candidate cache enumerates the tight pass over all nodes and the relaxed pass over UNMATCHED nodes only, so it is a strict subset of S1; verified subset + raw_um identical to 0.0 on the parity crop

gpu_cost.why: predict_unet_transformer.py::predict_video already computes the FULL (n_src, n_tgt) edge logit matrix per consecutive frame pair and applies softmax(dim=0) over ALL sources. cfg.threshold=0.5 plus max_parents=1/max_children=2 is what truncates the geff export at ~9.88 um -- there is no distance gate in the model. The union cache is an EXPORT-SURFACE change, not extra compute.
gpu_cost.normalisation_exactness: softmax is over the complete source set of the frame, which is the unchanged node population, so cached probabilities are identical to the ones the deployed model already computes.

checkpoints.resolution: same find_weights() order that produced oof_clean
